family: Actual Boolean activated quadratic bent point surgery: k=2, r=4, selector chooses b or b flipped at x=0; activation iff all controls are zero. This k=2 endpoint is not in the original k>=4 no-go theorem.
domain: Five fixed physical trees on one 7-bit truth table: controls then stop at selector core; controls then selector then stop; selector then controls then stop; controls/selector/data to constants; selector/controls/data to constants. Analytic control formulas checked at r=1,2,3,4 by independent raw truth tables; formula-only values at r=5..12.
case_count: 5 named trees, 4 raw-table formula comparisons, 12 formula summaries
symmetry: None; constant nodes stop explicitly; no orbit extrapolation.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transform, Fraction probabilities, exact prime-log vectors for identities; 96-term rational atanh intervals with power-of-two range reduction for numerical comparisons. Floating displays are not sign certificates.
